generationCommand: python gen-tatoeba-words.py --lang ky --script cyrillic --min-count 2 --stop 'tom,mary,john,jim,mike,ken,sami,layla,jane,bill,bob,jack,maria,mari,том,томдун' --out ky_words.v2.txt kir_text.txt ky_kloop.txt ky_sentence-collector.txt
inputPreparation: kir_text.txt = column 3 of kir_sentences.tsv (one sentence per line); the Common Voice files are used as downloaded

measurement.heldOut: 1 in 6 Common Voice sentences held out by SHA-256 of the sentence; lists built from Tatoeba + the other 5 in 6 with the same settings; share of held-out word tokens the list contains
measurement.note: the shipped list is built from ALL the sentences (it is larger than the measured one)

publishing: published beside the original ky_words.txt, which is unchanged: HarmoniKeyboard bundles and pins the original, and neither app adopts a new list without its own measurement
